author: Rob Price
title: Apple is finally doing something about the notorious MacBook Pro keyboard that everybody has been complaining about (AAPL)
text: Apple is finally doing something about the notorious MacBook Pro keyboard that everybody has been complaining about (AAPL) By Rob Price Jun 22, 2018, 5:38 pm 35 pts Apple is offering free keyboard repairs to MacBook and MacBook Pro customers who have been affected by certain keyboard issues. If you already paid for those repairs, Apple is issuing refunds. People have been complaining for years that the laptops' keyboard breaks easily, and can get jammed by a…
